pages.text: $(thing)SWR$() measures how well the antenna suits the radio's frequency. 1.0 is perfect; the higher it is, the more power bounces back into the radio instead of being radiated.$(br2)See it in Jade, on the $(l:radiocraft:antennas/tuners)antenna tuner$(/l), or with the $(item)antenna analyzer$(): right click an antenna, its balun, its coax or its radio and it names the band the antenna is resonant on, or the band it is near and whether it is too short or too long, with its SWR on every band.

Transmit into an SWR of $(thing)3 or worse$() and the radio's transmitter may $(thing)blow$(): a fizz and a puff of smoke. The worse the match, the sooner. A blown radio still receives, but keying it only gives loud static.$(br2)A $(thing)Cheap$() radio may instead go up like TNT.
pages.title: Blowing up

pages.text: Break a blown radio for its parts: everything it was crafted from except the crystal.$(br2)Test a transmitter safely on a $(item)dummy load$(): a perfect match on every band that only reaches about ten blocks.
pages.title: Salvage
